title: 古兰经背诵转录中的错误标注研究
summary: 该研究对100个古兰经背诵录音案例进行人工标注，包含348个评分单元和162个事件，提出可执行评估器同时评估标签与词位置。基线F1约0.5，而三个编码代理的初步测试F1跨度0.143至0.892，多数远超基线，剩余挑战主要在于标注约定而非检测。
summary_en: This study presents a completed human annotation of 100 Quran recitation cases with 348 scored units and 162 localized events, plus an executable evaluator scoring labels and word positions together. Baselines reach ~0.5 F1, while a pilot with three coding agents spans 0.143 to 0.892 F1, mostly far above baselines, with remaining challenges being annotation conventions rather than detection.
